description: Top 25 Ports by Dry Bulk Tonnage is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. The Top 25 Ports by Dry Bulk Tonnage section highlights the critical hubs for moving non-liquid, unpackaged commodities like grain, coal, iron ore, and fertilizer. Unlike container ports, which are dominated by the West and East Coasts, dry bulk tonnage is heavily concentrated in the Gulf Coast and Great Lakes regions, where the U.S. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 4 columns, among them Port, Imports, Exports, Domestic. The portal shows 2024-08-07 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
